about: Executable test vectors for the pure core. Format: 01-core.md Appendix A. Expected values follow from the rules cited in each case; `at: n` means the hash of that key in the pool after landing n (0 = initial files).

hash_cases.rule: 2.5 refs query: referrer keys plus one <path>@<module hash> entry per referrer module
2.6 text query members carry the match count
2.4 step 2 non-finite number differs from null
2.4 step 2 non-finite number differs from the string
